variants.headline: Party names a new leader
variants.body: A party has a new leader in {colony}. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: Leadership changes hands
variants.body: Leadership of a political party has changed in the colony. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: A new name at the head of the party
variants.body: A new leader is now at the head of a party in {colony}. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.
